At 10:59 UTC Ansem posted that his "pump wallet is hacked", which he believes came from unauthorized access to his Bullpen profile. Other posts dispute the hack claim, citing on-chain links to wallets he had funded. Three Pump.fun coins are members: The Black Bull (ANSEM, 9cRCn9...), the coin that was sold, whose pool opened on 2026-06-16 and whose description says 65% of its supply was sent to Ansem's wallet; The White Bull (DUVAL), whose description says "Euris has elected the new leader after Ansem is now gone!" and whose pool opened at 10:11 UTC on 2026-11-24; and a second The Black Bull (ANSEM, DD23R2...), which copies the original's name and ticker and opened at 09:14 UTC that day, during the selling. The hack is Ansem's claim and is not verified here; none of the new coins is shown to be connected to him. Measured: three coins across all their pools.
